title: Technical Application Lead
description:
**1. Role purpose**

The Technical Application Lead will be responsible for developing, maintaining and continuously improving business-critical applications supporting the organization's global Color IT landscape.

The role requires strong hands-on expertise in modern .NET, C#, Angular and Microsoft Azure, along with the ability to provide technical guidance to Agile development teams. The individual will drive end-to-end application delivery, ensure system stability, implement scalable solutions and progressively modernize existing applications while maintaining business continuity.

**2. Job description**

**Key responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain scalable enterprise applications using .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core and Angular.
* Develop and manage REST APIs, Web APIs and microservices.
* Build and maintain cloud-based solutions using Microsoft Azure services.
* Work with Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Storage Accounts, Key Vault and Application Insights.
* Develop responsive frontend applications using Angular, TypeScript, RxJS and NgRx.
* Implement secure authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, App Registrations and token-based authentication.
* Manage Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, YAML configurations and deployment processes.
* Work with Entity Framework, SQL Server and T-SQL for efficient data management.
* Apply software engineering best practices, including coding standards, dependency injection, unit testing and code reviews.
* Provide technical guidance and coordinate activities across Agile/Scrum development teams.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Solution Architects, DevOps Engineers and global stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot existing applications, investigate technical issues and implement low-risk improvements.
* Support modernization of legacy applications by identifying opportunities to migrate suitable functionalities to modern .NET and Azure services.
* Monitor application performance, ensure production stability and drive continuous improvement.

**3. Ideal candidate description (Ideal CDD)**

The ideal candidate should be a
**Senior Microsoft Full-Stack Developer with strong hands-on expertise in .NET, Angular and Microsoft Azure**
, capable of independently handling technical development, application troubleshooting and end-to-end delivery.

The candidate should have experience working in enterprise application environments and be comfortable handling both modern applications and existing legacy systems.

They should demonstrate technical ownership, problem-solving ability and experience guiding or coordinating Agile development teams.

**Ideal candidate profile:**

* 4–8 years of relevant software development experience.
* Strong hands-on development experience in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core and Web API.
* Good experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based application development.
* Strong Angular, TypeScript and RxJS knowledge.
* Experience in Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and YAML.
* Knowledge of microservices, REST APIs and system integration.
* Experience with SQL Server, Entity Framework and T-SQL.
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies and technical team coordination.
* Ability to troubleshoot, maintain and modernize existing applications.
* Strong communication skills and experience working with global stakeholders.

**4. Mandatory technical skills**

C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Microsoft Azure, Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Web API, REST API, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Azure DevOps, CI/CD Pipelines, YAML, Entity Framework, SQL Server, T-SQL, Microservices, Git, Agile, Scrum, Technical Leadership.

title: Senior Associate, Software Engineering
description:
BetaNXT
   

  

 The Company
   

  

 BetaNXT is the next wave in wealth management technology and outsourcing solutions. We focused on solving our customers most demanding integration challenges with flexible, efficient, connected solutions. Our products reduce enterprise cost, streamline operation processes, increase advisor productivity, and enhances the investor experience. Together with BetaNXT, wealth management firms are transforming their platforms into differentiating assets that enable scale and commercial growth.
   

  

 But we're not just invested in our customers; we're also invested in people. We know that our overall success is a combined effort, and we therefore strive to provide opportunities for our employees to learn, grow and thrive.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 BETA is a self\-clearing securities processing solution for wealth management firms. Built on years of expert knowledge and hands\-on experience, BETA provides critical back\-office controls including corporate action management, middle office exception management, and front office account management and trading tools for advisors.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Associate with hands\-on experience in production\-level, cloud\-hosted data\-as\-a\-service application. In this role, you will primarily work on data warehousing\- involving data modeling, ETL, and reverse ETL processes including hands on in Data Build Tool (DBT) or any such build tools. You will be responsible for querying using SQL,write functions and stored procedures, and more. On any given day, you might be architecting data ingestion and warehousing solutions, and delivering data to our customers or internal applications through queries and functions. You will follow best practices in code and design, secure coding practices, and review data architecture, modeling, and queries from development through to completion in a live production environment.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Reporting to the Manager, Technology Development , this role is part of a Scrum team for developing product (s) within the Data Platform team . The role will be involved with developing customer facing cloud hosted data as service products . This role necessitates meetings and require heavy collaboration within and across many teams . Our business model is hybrid, working from our B angalore campus.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Architect and implement data ingestion and warehousing solutions.
* Develop and maintain data models, ETL, and reverse ETL processes.
* Write and optimize SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures.
* Ensure best practices in code and design, including secure coding practices.
* Review and improve data architecture, modeling, and queries.
* Deliver data solutions to customers and internal applications.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to meet project goals.


 Your Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 2\-4 years of professional experience in a data\-related software engineering role.
* Experience in Snowflake, DBT models.
* Hands\-on experience with coding, analytical, and data querying knowledge.
* Experience with all phases of the software development life cycle and Agile software development.
* Solid design knowledge to create extensible, reusable data deliveries that meet architectural objectives and security assessments.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and quickly get up to speed.
* Ability to work autonomously and in teams.
* Excitement for new technologies and challenges of scale.
* Proficiency in:
* Data Build Tool (DBT) or any analogous tool
* Data warehousing, including data modeling, ETL, and reverse ETL
* SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures
* Various data delivery methodologies (files, streams, APIs)
* Understanding of data\-related application SDKs


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IAC) tools like Terraform.
* Familiarity with AWS
* Knowledge of programming languages such as Python and PowerShell.


 As a global business, we rely on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. Therefore we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world−regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under country or local law.
